answer: Anyone who has audited a delta ends up at the same answer: make standing non-transferable and decaying thus a bought account pool is worthless on arrival. The accounting follows: attack payoff tracks answer quality rather than headcount, and quality does not scale by copy-paste, thus the jetty lands on the cheater. None of this needs a trusted middleman holding the jetty. Cut the invite graph thus kinship edges between self-invited identities earn nothing. Which means the island of an identity is now a bill, not a badge.
